'''2006 Massachusetts State Championship Tim Simon LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tim Simon]] at [[2006 Massachusetts State Championship]], finishing 1st; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Tim "Aglets" Simon (2006-07-15).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35639 Aglets-style WHAP v3.0]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20070522172447/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35639&PHPSESSID=7256ac780cef1a43d27bb5fd5f225bdb Internet Archive]</ref>
